inlines.v: PUD'DING, noun 1. A species of food of a soft or moderately hard consistence, variously made, but usually a compound of flour, or meal of maiz, with milk and eggs, sometimes enriched with raisins and called plum-pudding. 2. An intestine. 3. An intestine stuffed with meat, ; etc. now called a sausage. 4. Proverbially, food or victuals. Eat your pudding slave, and hold your tongue. PUD'DING
